# laravelforge_site_nginx (Resource)

Manages the site-level raw Nginx configuration on a Laravel Forge site (singleton per site).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String) Raw Nginx configuration for the site.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site.
